reviews.text: We had an appointment at 8 am and were seen 50 minutes late. It's unacceptable that they tell you to let them know if you're going to be 15 minutes late or they won't see you immediately so as not to inconvenience other customers, and then you arrive on time and are seen 50 minutes late.

Luis provided exceptional service; it's clear he's passionate about his profession and was incredibly kind to both me and Chispa. He quickly identified what was wrong, and it's obvious he genuinely wants to help and isn't just trying to get paid. A million thanks from the bottom of my heart! We'll be back.
I've taken my two cats to him several times for vaccinations and checkups, and I couldn't be happier. Luis really knows how to handle angry cats :)
Excellent, I love it

Super happy with the service!!!
Highly recommend it!! Go with your puppies ❤️❤️
Delighted with the service!! They are all super attentive and lovely!
They are super friendly and professional... they treated my kitten wonderfully

A very negative experience due to poor organization and lack of professionalism.
They are always very late with the scheduled appointment. But the worst experience was with my dog's dental cleaning.
I was given two appointments. Both times I had to take a day off work, leave my dog ​​fasting for hours at the clinic, and after waiting, they called me to come pick him up because they canceled the appointment at the last minute.
The last time was unacceptable: I left him, they inserted the catheter and administered anesthesia, and hours later they called me to pick him up because the vet had been bitten by a dog just before my appointment and had to go to the private clinic. If they already knew he was unwell, they should have canceled BEFORE sedating my pet, not after. They handed him back to me still half asleep, with the catheter in place, and without having done anything.
Hours of fasting, stress for the animal, and a waste of time and money for me. On top of that, they gave me trouble canceling, claiming a one-year contract. I absolutely do not recommend it.

It's probably the worst clinic in Madrid. Both times I've taken my dog ​​there, something has gone wrong. The first time, they couldn't treat him because the surgeon's dog died before he could even work on mine, but he denied any fault, saying the tests were from another clinic and weren't up to date. This time, it happened to our dog; he almost died on the operating table from the anesthesia. Because of him, our dog had a seizure and has been unable to move, eat, or drink for six hours now (even though he's been fasting for almost 24 hours). The surgeon tried to shift the blame again, saying he'd been bitten earlier and had to go to the clinic because he wasn't feeling well. If he wasn't feeling well, why would he try anything with our dog? He's not a toy to experiment on; he's a living being. We've taken him off work because we're terrified of taking our dog to a clinic like this.
Excellent clinics that include (almost) everything for your pet. The veterinarians are very professional and friendly, and the receptionists are also very kind and helpful.
Excellent service, everyone was very professional, thank you ☺️
The best
If you want top-notch service, both the reception staff and the veterinary staff are friendly and professional. Highly recommended.

I arrived late for my dog's grooming appointment because I couldn't find parking. They told me they couldn't see him and that there were no appointments available until October 23rd.
It's incredibly frustrating having to wait over a month for an appointment every time, not to mention that I have to work that day and have to find a day off.
You pay for good service, but unfortunately, that's not what you get here.
Vanesa's service was wonderful, we've enrolled our two bulldogs and I know we'll do well ❤️
My trusted veterinarian, very professional and friendly from the first moment, and their excellent customer service is evident. Highly recommended.
Today I was there with my pet and Marian helped me at reception. She was incredibly attentive and provided excellent service. Thank you so much, I will definitely be back.

Dr. Ronald, the veterinarian, provided excellent care for our kitten, taking great care of him and answering all our questions.

He gave us excellent recommendations for our kitten's care.
Very long wait
Terrible service, little interest in helping me, how sad, especially in the middle of the shopping center! I was completely ignored
I went back with my dog ​​again and Marian, a super nice girl, helped me. She provided detailed information and was very professional 👏🏻 We loved it, thank you so much! …

Vanessa at reception was very kind and caring, as well as very efficient! All the vets are very professional and give their best. The only improvement would be slightly more detailed follow-up for each pet, but that's understandable given the number of pets that come through here. We, our bull terrier, two kittens, and a Chinese Crested dog are very happy with this vet in Canitas!! <3
The staff were all excellent. Marian, the receptionist, was super friendly and explained everything very well.
Excellent place, especially the girl from administration, Marian.
Excellent service from the receptionist, Marian.
My pet has been insured with them for over a year and it's fantastic, always providing the best solutions for our furry friends.
Friendly staff, good service and everything explained very well.

Rosa Del Mar Martín, thank you so much for those 5 stars!
We're so happy to have you here, sending you a huge hug and lots of good vibes 🌟🤗 …

⭐️ A terrible experience. I took my dog ​​in for emergency treatment for pneumonia, and they told us they would schedule a follow-up appointment for a week later. When we arrived, they told us the appointment hadn't been booked and they couldn't see him for another two weeks. A management error on their part that the animal ultimately paid for. Furthermore, the veterinarians' lack of empathy was disappointing: they refused to examine him and made us wait for hours only to finally tell us they wouldn't see him. It was heartbreaking to see my pet freezing for hours in those conditions.
My pet was seen by the veterinarian Ronald, a true professional. He solved all my problems, and I left delighted with the way he treated my pet.
Excellent service from all the staff. Thank you.
Excellent service from all the staff, it's great!
They treated my dog ​​very well
Very professional and excellent service.
It was my first appointment with Nicolás and he was very good, the service couldn't have been better. Congratulations to the center.
This clinic is excellent and highly recommended. They are very kind. Thank you very much.
We left the groomer's delighted with our kitten

So far they've been quick and efficient. We've finished the course very successfully.
Thanks Nico, Luis, and Laura.
Excellent experience

The service was fantastic from the moment we walked in until we left. Veterinarians Luis and Nico were very attentive to our Zeus. And the receptionists Angelica and Maricarmen were always very kind when we made an appointment and greeted us upon arrival. The groomer was very professional; we knew her from La Gavia and have now followed her to Plaza Río. She was always very gentle and patient with Zeus, as he's a very nervous dog. We're forever grateful to Canitas Plaza Río 2!
Momo's first vaccination! Luis did a fantastic job and the little dog didn't even notice. Thank you so much, Canitas! 🙏😘 …
The communication was excellent; they explained everything clearly. I fully understood my dog's treatment and how to proceed. That was greatly appreciated.
Excellent service as always! Delighted ❤️
Excellent service, I recommend it 100%.

Thank you for the service, you are very kind.
Thank you for your attention, I will return to Canelo.
Kei and Angelica are the best, kind, and provide amazing service. Thank you so much for your kindness ❤️

A very good experience at the clinic. I took my cat there, and from the very first moment, the treatment was excellent, both for him and for me. It's clear that Luis is experienced and truly cares about animals. He explained everything clearly, answered all my questions, and was very friendly and professional. I will definitely trust them again when I need to. Highly recommended!
Luis's service was wonderful, a true professional.

I want to especially thank Luis for the care and attention he gave my dog. From the very first moment, he was very professional and friendly, and it was clear he genuinely cared about the animal's well-being. He explained everything very clearly and patiently answered all my questions.

It's such a relief to find professionals like Luis, who treat animals with such love and dedication. I will definitely return to Canitas Veterinary Clinic CC Plaza 2 and highly recommend them.
Keilyn, thank you so much for your 5 stars! 🌟 You're part of our family, come back soon! 😉 …
Angelica is a very sweet girl ✨ thank you for treating my cat so well
Thank you for your trust, Ruben! We're so glad we could help; we're still excited to take care of your pet.
Excellent service. I left very happy with the attention and service from Veterinarian Juan, and the staff also provided excellent service ♥️
This clinic is a gem in Madrid, excellent service, the doctor understood our needs, and a very relaxed atmosphere for our pets. We are delighted we chose them. 🙂 …
Thank you so much! They took care of our dog in an emergency, and the service from both the reception staff and their veterinarian, Luis, was excellent. 8 out of 5 stars for the service!!
Excellent service, they were very kind to my cat and always available to help. So far, their dedication has been impeccable. I highly recommend them!
This is our first visit to Canitas and Sonia has been wonderful! I'm sure she'll be very kind to my dog ​​too! Thank you!

Thank you, Jennifer, for trusting us; we're so glad we could help.
It will always be a pleasure to care for your pet.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Diana! 🙌 You're family, come back soon! 😄✨ …

Very efficient, we're super happy 🐶🎉
Excellent service from Dr. Nico …

The first time I had my appointment at 2:30 PM, I was seen at 3:10 PM. The second time my appointment was at 4:40 PM, I was seen at 5:30 PM. They're a bit disorganized with the appointment system. They should change it.

Nicolás Miranda was incredibly kind, patient, and communicative. My Chihuahua had diarrhea while we were on vacation in the city, and he was able to get us a last-minute appointment right away. He performed a complete exam, took x-rays, and provided the necessary medication. Excellent customer service and truly exceptional care for my dog.
I loved the service from Niko, a very good professional and very caring with the little ones.

Dear Ali, thank you so much for your 5-star review.

We're delighted to hear you were satisfied; the Canitas team will be happy to continue caring for your pet.
We're here for you whenever you need us!
Very kind and attentive, I love how they treat the animals and their owners.
My dog ​​has been going to this clinic for about two years now, and they've taken wonderful care of her. The vet, who's from Argentina, is very good and dedicated.
Excellent service, we love Nico and Luis! 🙂 …

The staff is exceptional. Angelica at reception is very kind and professional. Veterinarians Luis, Nico, and Laura, besides being excellent professionals, treat their patients with great care. They go to great lengths to provide clear explanations of tests and treatments. I must also mention the magnificent work of groomer Key. She is very caring and competent. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic.
Vets Luis, Nico, and Laura took great care of my dog; they're so sweet... and the reception staff were super friendly.

I'm writing out of helplessness and frustration after spending three days with my dog ​​in critical condition at an independent veterinary hospital affiliated with Canitas.

Before taking out insurance with this company, think twice, because when you're in need, the clinic falls far short and is completely unresponsive. Our dog has been very ill for a week, and they haven't even considered performing an ultrasound, despite our repeated insistence that we were willing to pay for it just to find out what's wrong. During this week, all they've done is administer medication; they don't do any follow-up. We've had to keep calling (sometimes even to correct the prescribed medication dosage), and they make you feel like the calls are a nuisance (despite emphasizing the seriousness of her condition, the response is always, "We'll call you back when we can"). The prescribed medication may have worsened her condition.

We obviously have reports detailing everything her hospitalization entails, and we won't hesitate to take the appropriate measures.

Edit. The fact that the response to this review is to refer me to a generic form on the website is even more shameful than the treatment I received from the clinic.

It was a Monday, and there was no vet available despite my monthly fee. I went in for an emergency, but they said there was no one to see my pet. I tried to make an appointment, but they were fully booked. If it's a life-or-death situation, my pet will die.
Very good experience, Laura, the veterinarian who attended us, was wonderful and very pleasant; we were delighted to have her attend to us.
I've had to go several times lately, and I couldn't be happier. Thanks to the vets who always help me, and to the reception staff who are so nice!
Thank you so much for your trust, Alejandro! We're so glad we could help; we're always here to lovingly care for your pet.

The veterinary clinic is excellent, but the reception staff leaves much to be desired.
My experience with the clinic and the care my dog ​​receives has always been very good, but unfortunately, today I had a very unpleasant experience with the receptionist, Angelica. There was a mix-up with the appointment date—I don't know if it was my mistake or a communication error when scheduling it—and I arrived today with my dog, thinking it was the right day. Instead of trying to find a solution or explain the situation with even a little empathy, I received very rude, unpleasant, and unprofessional treatment, to the point that I ended up leaving with my dog.
I completely understand that an appointment can be incorrectly scheduled or that there can be a mistake, but I believe that the way clients are treated is fundamental, especially in a veterinary clinic where we go because we are concerned about our animals.
The veterinarian is great, and I have no complaints about her work, but the reception staff's service in this case was truly appalling. I hope this is taken into account, because poor service at reception can cause a customer to leave with a completely different impression of a place that I otherwise consider very good.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Irma! 😍 You're part of the family, come back soon and bring good vibes! ✨ …
Excellent service and attention. Fast and very professional.
Excellent service and they are very fast.

Could you call it a scam?
They advertise all-inclusive packages for €22.90 a month. You go in confident, thinking you have insurance that covers everything, or almost everything, and it turns out that whatever you need, it just so happens it's not covered, and they charge you a fortune, saying they'll cover a small percentage, which is practically nothing because they're still ripping you off. My advice: if you pass by, don't stop; they're going to scam you.
Nico took great care of my furry friend!

My experience with Canitas Madrid Río 2 has been very disappointing.

I hired this service because I wanted to spay my cat. During the process, I had to pay for the pre-operative tests and was also going to cover my share of the surgery costs. In addition, my cat had to be pricked twice to draw blood because she is very nervous and wouldn't cooperate.

After several months of waiting, I went to ask why they hadn't called me for the surgery, and that's when they told me they had tried to reach me, but I wasn't answering. Upon checking, we verified that my phone number was correctly registered in the system, and they also had my email address, but the error was that they had entered my number incorrectly in the internal address book they used to schedule calls.

I asked them why I had to start the entire process again if the mistake was theirs. They told me I would have to repeat the tests, wait several more months for another appointment, and, on top of that, wait until after summer. Meanwhile, my cat was going into heat approximately every ten days and still needed to be spayed.

Faced with this situation, I decided to go to another veterinary clinic and pay for the procedure there, because I couldn't wait any longer.

On April 15, 2025, I submitted a written complaint and requested the cancellation of the contract due to what had happened. Canitas confirmed that they had received my complaint and would forward it to the relevant department, but I never received a response or a solution.

For this reason, I stopped paying the fees. Now, more than a year later, instead of responding to my complaint, I have received a payment demand from a law firm claiming the outstanding fees, without anyone having addressed the problem that caused this whole situation.

This has been my personal experience, and unfortunately, I have felt completely neglected.
Thank you for trusting us, Tania! We're so glad we could help your pet. 🐾 …
Thank you so much for your trust, Edanis Acuña! We're so glad we could help. 🐾 …

I don't usually write negative reviews, but I can't hold back any longer. I've had problems with billing before, but I decided to let it go. But this is unbearable. I took my Yorkshire Terrier to the groomer for the first time, and they did a terrible job, honestly awful. Everything was badly cut, as if they'd done it half-heartedly. They bathed him and left his ears dirty, and they didn't even trim his nails, which I asked them to. This is just unbearable. They do whatever they want. I'm very upset. They're completely unprofessional.
I received excellent service and the result was exactly what I was looking for.

Thank you for your trust, Iris!
We're so glad we could help and we're always here to care for your pet.

WARNING: Don't put your pets at risk here.
I enrolled my two cats and two dogs at this clinic with high expectations, but the management has been utterly negligent and a constant headache.
The worst incident involved my dog, Tommy: for months they insisted that a lump he had was just a "fatty lump," delaying surgery and giving me the runaround. It turned out to be a malignant tumor that they let grow and then tried to ignore for months.
To make matters worse, given the seriousness of the situation, I urgently requested my animals' medical records, and the response was that it would take more than 10 days due to "internal bureaucracy." It's unacceptable that they withhold an animal's medical history when its life depends on it. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.
100% recommended! Canitas and the grooming salon are excellent; they made my dog ​​look exactly how I wanted. I'm super happy, thank you Keyla!
